== Description ==

[[Ryan Jellison]] (left, white Summer League T-shirt and glasses) playing [[Karl Koenig]] (right, red pullover and black shorts) in the tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; background faces unlabeled.
